description: Least privilege for the main window. Every file, registry, process and shell effect happens in Rust behind an explicit command, and dialogs and right-click menus are shown from Rust, so the page needs no fs, shell, dialog, menu or process permission: only showing its window once painted, telling the frame its theme, and hearing the notification-area icon ask for a page (open-page). Add a permission here only with the ui/src call that needs it.
